reason: Only the Expo CLI's copy is affected; the app itself uses zod 4.6.7. Clears when Expo updates its CLI.

In the app bundle: Expo Router parses route and deep-link query strings with it. The risk is slow decoding (denial of service) of a crafted percent-encoded URL on the patient's own phone, not data exposure. The fix (0.5.1) is a new major version that query-string 7 doesn't support, so forcing it could break routing. Clears when Expo Router moves to a fixed query-string; recheck on each Expo SDK update.
